glossary.truco.name: truco
glossary.truco.def: A call to raise the hand's value. The other team accepts, runs or raises again.
glossary.tento.name: tento
glossary.tento.def: One point on the score. The game goes to 12 points.
glossary.vira.name: vira
glossary.vira.def: In paulista, the card turned up after the deal. The next rank becomes the manilha.
glossary.manilha.name: manilha
glossary.manilha.def: The four strongest cards of the hand. In paulista they change with the vira; in mineiro they are fixed.
glossary.zap.name: zap
glossary.zap.def: The manilha of clubs, the strongest card.
glossary.mao.name: mão
glossary.mao.def: One deal: three cards each and up to three rounds. It is also the player who leads, to the right of the dealer.
glossary.rodada.name: rodada
glossary.rodada.def: Everyone plays one card and the strongest takes it.
glossary.copas.name: copas
glossary.copas.def: The manilha of hearts, the second strongest.
glossary.espadilha.name: espadilha
glossary.espadilha.def: The manilha of spades, the third.
glossary.picafumo.name: pica-fumo
glossary.picafumo.def: The manilha of diamonds, the weakest of the four.
glossary.onze.name: mão de onze
glossary.onze.def: In paulista, when a team reaches 11: it sees both hands and plays for 3 or runs.
glossary.dez.name: mão de dez
glossary.dez.def: In mineiro, when a team reaches 10: it plays for 4 or runs.
glossary.ferro.name: mão de ferro
glossary.ferro.def: Both teams on the threshold: nobody sees their own cards and the hand decides the game.
glossary.coberta.name: carta coberta
glossary.coberta.def: A card played face down. It is worth nothing and is not allowed in the first round.
glossary.correr.name: correr
glossary.correr.def: To fold on a call. The caller takes the value from before.
glossary.desce.name: desce
glossary.desce.def: A way to say you accept the truco.
glossary.aumentos.name: aumentos
glossary.aumentos.def: Six, nine and twelve in paulista; six, ten and twelve in mineiro. Each asks for more than the last.
glossary.queda.name: queda
glossary.queda.def: One game to 12 in a best of three match.
glossary.sinal.name: sinal
glossary.sinal.def: A hint to your partner about your cards. Each opponent sees it with a 25% chance. It may be a lie.
